task: Pin the Narwhal IDP Portal image to the published release 1.1.11 (was 1.1.10); the repository change is static and no cluster rollout was performed.

events.summary: Tag bump of one image in the GitOps manifest, its air-gap inventory and digest pin, the docs that quote the pin, and the committed OSS-updates snapshot regenerated by gen-oss-versions.mjs. No manifest structure, env, RBAC or chart change. No merge, no Gitea push and no cluster rollout in this change.

ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.1.11 was published from tag portal/v1.1.11 on 90dbfaad2d2a665a845f43a8319c9a65cf4363aa. Checked 2026-11-10T02:12:53Z: crane resolves the tag to index digest sha256:368a626150eb461e09df4793edc44bf3b33b0dcdf2ee93a0e10c8a5f8c5b5283 and cosign verify with scripts/airgap/keys/cosign.pub passes on it. Local Vagrant nodes pull ghcr.io directly; a cluster whose nodes cannot reach ghcr.io must mirror by digest first (scripts/airgap/README.md, Mirror a pin bump).

Pin moved 1.1.10 -> 1.1.11 in the Deployment image, images.txt and image-digests.tsv (new digest), gitops README pins and prose (en/ko), VERSIONS.md (IDP Portal row), compatibility-matrix, SECURITY.md example and the Unreleased changelog entries (en/ko); portal/src/data/oss-versions.generated.json regenerated with gen-oss-versions.mjs. 1.1.11 applies the Figma split-layout login (#619, #620); the root Unreleased pin entry now reads 1.1.11 (was 1.1.9) since 1.1.10 never shipped in a narwhal release.
Local static checks only; no live cluster verification was run for this pin.
The repository pins the IDP Portal to 1.1.11 consistently with a digest that matches the registry and a verified Cosign signature.
Complete within the stated scope: static pin change only. Not covered: local-cluster rollout and any Kakao or other bastion-mirrored cluster.
